dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Why, this "Kamera" contraption captures quite the nice images, it seems...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Yes... We recently imported a new product from Fontaine. It's supposed to be very popular over there at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: It's a device that... Well, you press a button, and it makes an image on a piece of paper.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: They're calling it a "Kamera"... I must say, I'm having quite a lot of fun with it. Have you heard of such a device?

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Really? Haha, well, I suppose I should have expected you to be more knowledgeable than me, as a traveler.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Our young master has also taken a great liking to this Kamera. He's convinced that it will sell very well.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: But given that this would be the first sale of this device, we don't have any guarantee that it'll be a success. As such, we've decided to run a trial event where citizens can come and have a free "photograph" taken first.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: To our surprise, it was rather well-received. Quite a few people offered to pay a small fee for us to bring the Kamera to them and "take a picture"...

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Some people also requested that we have the image framed and mounted and deliver it to them. But the number of people coming to us to have their pictures taken is now growing by the day.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: I had intended to discuss the situation with the young master, but he's been gone for several days now.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: In the meantime, we don't want to neglect our customers, so we've been doing our best to attend to everyone who comes to have their picture taken. But there are so many people now that we are struggling to keep on top of demand.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Traveler, could you do me a favor and deliver these two pictures to our customers?
